mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_notice n where n.status = '0' and not exists (select 1 from sys_notice_read r where r.notice_id = n.notice_id and r.user_id = #{userId})

select n.notice_id as noticeId, n.notice_title as noticeTitle, n.notice_type as noticeType, n.status, n.create_by as createBy, n.create_time as createTime from sys_notice n where n.status = '0' order by n.notice_id desc limit #{limit}
